category_title: Eighth-grade students with ASD showing low academic engagement during math instruction
scenario_title: Eighth-grade general education math class activities
minimal_context: The student is in their fourth-period eighth-grade general education math class, expected to complete practice problems in a peer-supported group.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time to complete the practice problems with your group. Please use your calculator to solve the first one.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Does not follow the direction within 10 seconds and begins doodling instead of writing down answers to the problems.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You need to work on the math. What do you think the answer is?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I'm not doing it. (Pulls out a non-math book and starts reading.)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please put the book away and try to do the assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Verbally refuses to do the work again, puts head down on the desk, and fails to complete the assignment during the allotted time.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time to complete the practice problems with your group. Please use your calculator to solve the first one.

STUDENT: (Does not follow the direction within 10 seconds and begins doodling instead of writing down answers to the problems.)

TUTOR: You need to work on the math. What do you think the answer is?

STUDENT: I'm not doing it. (Pulls out a non-math book and starts reading.)

TUTOR: Please put the book away and try to do the assignment.

STUDENT: (Verbally refuses to do the work again, puts head down on the desk, and fails to complete the assignment during the allotted time.)

task.content: Completing an introductory warm-up activity, taking notes during teacher presentation of information, completing practice problems, using a calculator to solve problems, and beginning homework assignments

context.materials: Calculator, self-management checklist with written reinforcer, tangible reinforcers (e.g., candy) or access to reinforcing activity (e.g., computer time), non-math book

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: During the baseline and withdrawal conditions when participants are not given a checklist to guide them through the class activities
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Display low levels of academic engagement and often fail to complete assignments during the allotted time

behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Verbally refusing to do work, putting head down, not following directions within 10 s, and engaging in non-math tasks (e.g., reading a book, doodling)
